title: UneceContract
description: An agreement between two or more parties for trade purposes.

automaticExtensionDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value of automatic extension for this trade contract.

automaticExtensionDurationMeasure.description: The measure of the duration of the automatic extension for this trade contract.

description.description: A textual description of this trade contract.

identifier.description: The unique identifier of this trade contract.

issueDateTime.description: The date, date time, or other date time value for the issuance of this trade contract.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this trade contract.

signatureName.description: A signature name, expressed as text, for this trade contract.

signedDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value when this trade contract was signed.

signedLocation.description: A location where this trade contract was or will be signed.

signeeJobTitle.description: A job title of the signee, expressed as text, for this trade contract.
